risk_if_not_implemented: Without Out-of-Band Channels, adversaries may move laterally, exfiltrate data or reach systems that should have been isolated from untrusted networks. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Transportation / Logistics Disruption (MT-26).

compensating_control_1.name: Telecommunications Services Availability
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to reduce the likelihood of a single point of failure with primary telecommunications services.
compensating_control_1.justification: Telecommunications Services Availability (BCD-17) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Out-of-Band Channels (NET-07) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Remote Access
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to define, control and review organization-approved, secure remote access methods.
compensating_control_2.justification: Remote Access (NET-26) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Out-of-Band Channels (NET-07) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
